name: CreateAccount
label: Create Salesforce Account
description: Creates a new Account record in Salesforce using the provided credentials and account details.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: Resource
fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The Salesforce object to operate on. Must be 'Account'.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: The operation to perform on the resource. Must be 'Create'.

fields.name: Name
fields.label: Account Name
fields.description: The name of the Account to create (required).

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: Optional additional fields to include when creating the Account (e.g., Industry, Phone, Website).

fields.name: AccountId
fields.label: Created Account ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the newly created Account record.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after creating the Account.
